findings.title: ValueError 构造参数错误导致异常消息格式异常
findings.explanation: raise ValueError("Invalid max_wbits value %r; allowed range 8-%d", max_wbits, zlib.MAX_WBITS) 将三个参数传给 ValueError，而不是用 % 格式化。ValueError 的 args 会变成三元组，str(e) 输出为元组字符串 "('Invalid max_wbits value %r; allowed range 8-%d', 7, 15)"，占位符未被替换，错误信息对调用者不可读。
findings.trigger: 构造 _PerMessageDeflateCompressor(persistent=False, max_wbits=7)，触发 8 <= max_wbits 检查失败。
findings.evidence:
第 733-737 行：raise ValueError(
    "Invalid max_wbits value %r; allowed range 8-%d",
    max_wbits,
    zlib.MAX_WBITS,
) 缺少 % 运算符。
findings.suggestion: 改为 raise ValueError("Invalid max_wbits value %r; allowed range 8-%d" % (max_wbits, zlib.MAX_WBITS))。
findings.snippet:
731:         # There is no symbolic constant for the minimum wbits value.
732:         if not (8 <= max_wbits <= zlib.MAX_WBITS):
733:             raise ValueError(
734:                 "Invalid max_wbits value %r; allowed range 8-%d",
735:                 max_wbits,
736:                 zlib.MAX_WBITS,
737:             )
738:         self._max_wbits = max_wbits
739:
